activation.reason: Two exact cells first reached three positive prior observations only after the sealed 2025-10-07 result. M1 must therefore be numerical for the next comparable target, never retroactively.

numerical_freeze.M0: Freeze the last positive local observation and any preregistered transition density support.
numerical_freeze.M1: Use the model-core Jeffreys-reference Student-t predictive on prior local log outcomes; freeze point, log location, log scale and degrees of freedom before the result.
numerical_freeze.M2: Retain the exact phase and preregistered convolution, with the additional requirement of at least two prior distinct event dates carrying same-phase M1 innovations.
numerical_freeze.BMA: Remain NOT_ESTIMABLE until M0, M1 and M2 densities share support on the same frozen target.

same_event_batch_rule.one_prior: Every outcome in one auction event is scored against the same sealed pre-event prior.
same_event_batch_rule.posterior_update: After all scoring, append all valid exact-cell outcomes as one event batch. Multiple objects may remain multiple target observations; they are never averaged into one synthetic target.
same_event_batch_rule.M1_innovations: When pre-event M1 is estimable, every same-event outcome innovation is computed against that same pre-event M1 location.
same_event_batch_rule.M2_distinct_event_gate: Multiple innovations from one event date count as one event toward seasonal support.

scoring.M0_point: absolute price error and volume MALE
scoring.M1_point: absolute price error and volume MALE when frozen
scoring.M1_density: Student-t log density on log outcome minus log actual outcome Jacobian
